headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Munsif Daily / The Hindu / India Today / Telangana Today
bullets_en: Trump calls Iranian leaders ‘crazy’, chants ‘Praise be to Allah’.
KTR has sought early construction of JNTU engineering college campus in Sircilla.
PM Modi, CM Vijay flag off first train on Chennai Metro phase 2 network; share ride.
Flash flood hits northern Nepal, sweeps away 35 houses; army joins rescue ops.
Telangana farmers protest over power cuts, demand uninterrupted electricity supply.
bullets_ur: Trump ne Irani rehnumaon ko ‘pagal’ qarar diya, ‘Allah ki tareef ho’ ke naare lagaye.
KTR ne Sircilla mein JNTU engineering college ke campus ki fori tameer ka mutaliba kiya.
PM Modi aur CM Vijay ne Chennai Metro ke phase 2 ki pehli train rawana ki; mushtarqa safar kiya.
Shumali Nepal mein sailab se 35 makaanat beh gaye; fauj bhi rescue operations mein shareek.
Telangana mein bijli bandish par kisanon ka ehtijaj, bila-waqfa bijli farahami ka mutaliba.
